mandate: C436 — test the price-only CROSS-ASSET MUTUAL INFORMATION symmetric-information-dependence stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0); m[t]=mean_i r_i[t] (equal-weight market return). Causal trailing mean mu[t] and std sigma[t] of {r[t-W_q+1..t]}, W_q=256 (fallback 128). Standardized return z[t]=(r[t]-mu[t])/sigma[t] (z[t]=0 if sigma[t]<=0 or non-finite). Per trailing window of z: bin each series into B=8 equal-frequency quantile bins; for each UNORDERED pair (i,j), i<j, compute MI_{i<->j} = sum over (x,y) of p(x,y)*log2[p(x,y)/(p(x)*p(y))] using per-window 2D bincount histograms. mi_mean, mi_max, mi_conc, mi_disp. NaN if t<W_q or any NaN/non-finite in window or sigma[t]<=0. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (mi_mean_dev, mi_max_dev, mi_conc_dev, mi_disp_dev) + 4 placebos (i.i.d. permutation seed 20261300 of the standardized returns, same marginal, destroyed serial/dependence geometry). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W_q or sigma[t]<=0 or NaN in trailing window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0).
methodology.primitives: causal trailing mean/std mu[t], sigma[t] of {r[t-W_q+1..t]}, W_q=256 (fallback 128); standardized return z[t]=(r[t]-mu[t])/sigma[t]; per trailing window bin each series into B=8 equal-frequency quantile bins; MI_{i<->j} = sum over (x,y) of p(x,y)*log2[p(x,y)/(p(x)*p(y))] over unordered pairs (i,j), i<j, using per-window 2D bincount histograms; mi_mean, mi_max, mi_conc, mi_disp.
methodology.signals: mi_mean_dev/mi_max_dev/mi_conc_dev/mi_disp_dev plus i.i.d.-permutation-surrogate placebos over W_q=256 (seed 20261300); score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: i.i.d. permutation (seed 20261300) of the standardized returns z before the MI pipeline; same marginal distribution, destroyed serial/dependence geometry; deterministic seed recorded; never market data, never fabricated.
methodology.mi_vectorization_note: rolling mean/std via cumulative sums O(N); sliding trailing windows of z; equal-frequency quantile binning via per-window ranking; per-window 2D bincount histograms of (x_i, x_j) for all unordered pairs; MI from joint/marginal counts; vectorized derivation of mi_mean/mi_max/mi_conc/mi_disp per bar. Validated against a naive per-window explicit double-loop MI reference with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
